Hi @{author}. Thanks for contributing to `cf`!

During the open beta, we’re being very intentional about the changes we accept so that we can prioritise stability for GA. We’re limiting pull requests to contributions coordinated with the team in advance, so this PR has been automatically closed.

We’d still love to hear about your use case, so please make sure it’s captured in a [`cf` issue](https://github.com/cloudflare/cf/issues). If the proposed change fits our priorities, we’d be happy to take another look at this PR.
